import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { wayTags } from "../../../backend/schema/way_tags";

export const wayTagsCms = customizeTable<typeof wayTags>("way_tags", {
    icon: "Tag",
    display: {
        title: "v"
    },
    fields: {
        v: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["wayId", "k", "version", "v"]
});
